problem: Brokers spend hours on quoting, policy checking, proposals, submissions and commissions done by hand across documents.
business_model: B2B SaaS for brokerages (pricing not found)
product_category: AI workflow automation for insurance brokers

founders.name: Aman Raghuvanshi
education: Claremont McKenna College via Harvey Mudd, CS, 2018
founders.background_notes: YC page lists three AI patents.

founders.name: Emily Dorsey
education: Harvey Mudd College, CS and French, 2018

technical_complexity.rationale: Document comparison and extraction in 2023 needed LLM and OCR integration; insurance-specific accuracy and carrier-format variety were the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow depth with brokers could stick, but AI document tools were easy to copy by 2025.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent copy found; a broker customer (Prestige) bought the product in 2026.

market_need_then: Pyq began as a general document comparison tool; brokers asked for commissions, proposals, quoting and submissions (AIM Media House interview). More than 50 brokerages used it per that interview.

rebrands.why: Buyer Prestige Trucking Insurance relaunched the platform as an AI technology arm for the industry

brand_strength.rationale: Mulligan name origin not found; the product was launched Oct 2025 under the Pyq company name and was renamed within six months of the sale.

pivots.to: End-to-end AI automation for commercial insurance brokers (Mulligan)
pivots.why: Brokers pulled it into commissions, proposals, quoting and submissions (AIM Media House interview)

outcome_analysis: The company began as Pyq, a document comparison tool, and found its niche with insurance brokers who pulled it into quoting and proposals; it launched Mulligan in October 2025 and was acquired by an early customer, Prestige Trucking Insurance, in April 2026. Price and funding history are not public, so the exit size and whether it was a soft landing are unknown.
notes: Investors named in press: YC and WillowTree Ventures; no amounts found. The YC record is listed as Winter 2023 under the Mulligan name; the company operated as Pyq. Later AI-for-brokers entrants (Meshed, Panora, Ancep, Outmarket, Cara, Qumis, Rosella) emerged in 2025-2026 and are not dated competitors at founding. Chatgate.ai pages are AI aggregators and not relied on.
